test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 26 Dec, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A solid rubber sphere weighs 6 kg when its diameter is 6 cm. Using the same material, a hollow sphere is made with outer diameter 18 cm and inner diameter 12 cm. What is its weight?
solution: __Shortcut Trick__ Weight of a **sphere** is directly proportional to its **volume** (W ∝ V). Volume of a solid sphere ∝ r³ and Volume of a hollow sphere ∝ (R³ − r³). Ratio of Volumes = 3³ : (9³ − 6³) = 27 : (729 − 216) = 27 : 513. Given, 27 units = 6 kg ⇒ 1 unit = 6 ÷ 27 kg. Weight of hollow sphere = 513 × (6 ÷ 27) = 19 × 6 = 114 kg. **∴ The correct answer is 114 kg.**
